For example:   - If I want to invest ₹10 lakh or more in one go during market correction, it is not possible smoothly using mandate   - I have to split transactions or use manual payment, which defeats the purpose of AutoPay    Other platforms like NJ Wealth provide higher mandate flexibility (₹20–50 lakh or more), which is much more practical for high-value investors.  👉 Request:   Please introduce higher mandate limits (₹20–50 lakh or customizable based on user profile and bank approval), especially via net banking/eMandate.  ---  2) Limited SIP Frequency Options   Currently, SIP options are limited to monthly (and some dates).    👉 Missing features:   - Daily SIP option   - Weekly SIP option    These are very useful for:   - Better cost averaging   - Investing during volatile markets   - More flexible cash flow management    Many investors prefer daily/weekly SIP to capture market movements more effectively.  ---  ✅ Overall:   Groww is a very user-friendly and excellent platform, but these limitations make it less suitable for high-value and advanced investors.  Improving mandate limits and adding flexible SIP frequencies will significantly enhance the platform experience.

Disappointing Trading Experience with the Groww App. I have been using the Groww app for my trading activities for some time now, and unfortunately, my experience has been far from satisfactory. The app's regular lagging during trading sessions is incredibly frustrating and has cost me valuable opportunities. Regrettably, Groww's stop-loss functionality is far from dependable. There have been numerous instances where the stop-loss orders were not executed properly, causing significant losses on my trades. It's alarming to see stop-loss orders being executed at 5% loss, only to refresh the app and find it has ballooned to 15% or even 20%. Such discrepancies are simply unacceptable and have shaken my trust in the app.    Moreover, the lack of prompt customer support from Groww adds to the frustration. When I encountered issues with the app, reaching out for assistance proved to be an arduous process, and the responses were often generic and unhelpful.    The app's user interface is visually appealing and offers a wide variety of investment options, but all of these features become meaningless if the basic functionality of the app is severely flawed.    As a result of these consistent issues, I can't help but consider Groww as one of the worst trading apps I've ever used. Trading is a fast-paced activity, and such lags and glitches can have severe financial consequences for users. I genuinely hope that Groww addresses these issues promptly and diligently, as it has the potential to be a great platform if it can deliver a seamless and reliable trading experience.    In its current state, I cannot recommend the Groww app for trading purposes. It's vital to have confidence in the platform you use for investing, and unfortunately, the app's persistent lagging and unreliable stop-loss functionality have robbed me of that trust.
